script:
// Enterprise Sales Load Script
SET DateFormat='MM/DD/YYYY';
SET ThousandSep=',';
SET DecimalSep='.';

Orders:
LOAD
    OrderID,
    OrderDate,
    ShipDate,
    ShipMode,
    CustomerID,
    Segment,
    Region,
    Country,
    City,
    Sales,
    Quantity,
    Discount,
    Profit
FROM [lib://DataFiles/Orders.csv] (txt, codepage is 1252, embedded labels, delimiter is ',', msq);

Products:
LOAD
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    Category,
    SubCategory,
    UnitCost
FROM [lib://DataFiles/Products.csv] (txt, codepage is 1252, embedded labels, delimiter is ',', msq);
